alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A dark blue room with a window. Two small block figures with white eyes face each other, an amber one on the left and a light blue one on the right. The blue one pulses again and again as if talking while the amber one nods, then looks up, then drifts into a half-closed squint but keeps nodding. When the blue one stops, the amber one's eyes go wide and it trembles, then narrows its eyes at the camera. The text stays: me nodding like I'm listening.
